latest_validated_core_feature_head.message: Core v2: hydrate approved visual from verified provenance
latest_validated_core_feature_head.functional_increment: When an already-approved historical visual is absent from the repository, Instagram identity audit can now attempt ephemeral shadow-only hydration from the exact approved HTTPS direct source, but only after independent provenance-page ImageObject identity and license verification. Hydration never grants publication authority and fails closed on any provenance or download failure.

blocked.reason: Five of seven current written shadow candidates still lack a verified story-specific real, relevant and rights-cleared visual.
The exact approved Wikimedia provenance is independently verified, but the original direct asset is rate-limited HTTP 429 and the repository copy is absent; no substitute was introduced.
The water-contract approved social visual remains unbound to the canonical/public site story.
Read-only Graph access still lacks sufficient permission for receipt-bound Facebook delivery verification.
Official CJ Vâlcea source still cannot establish a verified TLS chain from the Core runner; certificate verification stays enabled.
Raw registration window is verified but its year is not explicit in that row; no normalized 2026 deadline is promoted.
No story yet satisfies the complete independent source + FactKernel + article + photo + site + FB + IG + receipt + audit chain.
Explicit owner approval remains mandatory before merge, deploy or live Core v2 publication/distribution.
